svg.title: From observation to supported conclusions
svg.desc: Supplement: these are not three automatically established conclusions. Explain evidence and limits at every level. Observation: The configuration permits anyone with the link to read. Inference: Unauthorized disclosure is possible, not yet established. Verification: Authorized tests check permissions; logs support incident analysis, but missing records do not prove no incident.
